Profit and Loss Statement — Edit

The Profit and Loss Statement shows your business performance over a period of time.

It displays revenues earned and expenses incurred to calculate net profit or loss.

Configure date ranges to analyze profitability for any period - monthly, quarterly, or annually.

Title

The title that will appear at the top of the report. Leave blank to use the default title.

Description

An optional description or subtitle that appears below the title. This can be used to provide additional context about the report.

Periods

Define the time periods to include in the report. You can add multiple periods to create comparative columns showing different date ranges side by side.

Accounting method

Choose whether to use accrual basis (recognizes revenue when earned and expenses when incurred) or cash basis (recognizes transactions only when cash changes hands) accounting.

Rounding

Select how numbers should be rounded in the report. Options include showing full amounts, rounding to thousands, or rounding to millions.

Groups to collapse

Select account groups that should be collapsed (show only the group total) in the report. This helps create a more concise report by hiding individual account details for selected groups.

Footer

Optional footer text that appears at the bottom of the report. This can be used for notes, disclaimers, or additional information.

Show account codes

Check this box to display account codes alongside account names in the report.

Exclude zero balances

Check this box to hide accounts with zero balances from the report, making it more concise.

Income accounts appear at the top, followed by expense accounts, with net profit/loss at the bottom.

Use comparative columns to analyze trends across multiple periods.

Filter by divisions or projects to analyze segment profitability.
